leagueDuel.scoreRule: A standard game must reach at least 11 points with a two-point margin.
leagueDuel.rosterHelp: 2. Select season players. Changing the roster clears saved draft squads. The roster locks when games are generated.
leagueDuel.tierComposition: Each squad has the same number of top, middle, and bottom-tier players, ranked from the selected roster.
leagueDuel.rebuildDraft: Refresh the options and save a tier-matched draft before generating games. This rebuild preserves the selected season roster.

priorityHelp.balance: Keeps individual games within the balance quality range, then favors equal season win chances. Tier meeting limits always apply.
priorityHelp.opponent_variety: Prioritizes spreading opponent meetings, then equal season win chances. Some games may be less evenly matched.

leagueDuel.draftMetrics: Highest favorite: {{percent}}% · Maximum opponent meetings: {{meetings}} · Repeated partnerships: {{repeats}}
leagueDuel.opponentLimits: Opponent meeting limits per player: top {{top}}, middle {{middle}}, bottom {{bottom}}. Each opponent pair must respect both players’ limits.
leagueDuel.refreshHelp: Refresh offers different squads within the tier meeting limits: balance stays within 5 percentage points of the best highest-favorite probability; variety keeps the best opponent spread with up to 6 extra previous partnerships.
leagueDuel.sameSquads: Both priorities currently favor the same squads; their match lineups may differ.
leagueDuel.saveBeforeGenerate: Save the currently selected squads and priority before generating games.
leagueDuel.noAlternative: No other squads meet this priority’s quality limits.
leagueDuel.noEligible: No draft meets 55/45 and this priority’s game-quality and opponent limits. Review the roster or ratings, then refresh. The limits stay in place.
leagueDuel.seasonBalanceLimit: Both options and every refresh keep season win chances between 45% and 55%. When joint champions are possible, this compares A and B excluding that outcome.
leagueDuel.seasonBalanceRequired: This draft exceeds the 55/45 season limit. Refresh and save an eligible option before generating games.
leagueDuel.restarted: All eligible alternatives have been shown. Starting another cycle.
leagueDuel.forecastCoverage: All {{total}} games · {{remaining}} remaining; recorded results are fixed.
leagueDuel.forecastHelp: Estimated from each doubles lineup and current ratings, assuming independent games.
leagueDuel.forecastUnavailable: Season forecast unavailable until every remaining lineup has ratings.
